notes:
- Company: Aurora Codemist — building intelligent IDE copilots for enterprise engineering teams.
- Primary product: VSCode + JetBrains plugins that stream token-by-token completions and context-aware refactor suggestions. Low tail latency is critical for UX.
- POC ask: Dedicated capacity to guarantee predictable throughput during peak developer hours (10:00-14:00 PST) with burst policy for CI/merge spikes.
- Performance targets: median token latency <= 50-75ms, p95 end-to-end streaming <200ms for 512-token completions.
- Model constraints: need model/version pinning per-release (pinable to semver), deterministic fallbacks to smaller quantized variants for background tasks.
- Workload patterns: many short sessions (~20-60s), high fan-out when repo-wide code actions invoked. Prefix/KV caching and warm kernel paths important.
- Cost sensitivity: looking for predictable monthly committed spend; prefer reserved capacity pricing with well-defined burst billing. Estimated ARR target $120k-$250k.
- Security/compliance: must support org SSO (SAML), audit logging with 90-day retention, KMS-managed keys, and US data residency.
- Integrations: telemetry hooks to their analytics (segment) and rollout flags for model rollouts.
- Quote from CTO: "We need zero-surprise perf — developers lose trust after 2 bad completions."
- Open items: security questionnaire (in legal), exact SLA for burst capacity, PO/payment terms, verify dedicated sizing against nightly CI load.
- Artifacts: PoC plugin, sample traces in Drive, security FAQ link above.
proposal_summary: Proof-of-Value: 60-day Dedicated pool with autoscale headroom for burst windows, model pinning enabled, pricing as committed monthly + burst rate. Includes SE support + integration runbook.
decision_criteria: 1) Meets latency SLOs in PoV (median & p95 stream). 2) Clear burst SLA and transparent billing. 3) Security checklist green. 4) Smooth plugin integration path (minimal SDK changes).
